newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to issue 6-mo Bubills next week-Buba.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to issue 6-mo Bubills next week-Buba.

text.p: The German government will issue six-month Treasury Bills, or Bubills, next week in a tender to be set on Tuesday, October 15, and bids are due by 0900 GMT on Wednesday, October 16, the Bundesbank said.
The settlement date for the paper is October 18, the Bundesbank added. Further details of the issue will be released when the tender is set.
The volume of the issue will be up to nine billion marks, according to the government's debt issue calendar for the final quarter of 1996.
